text:
sara_marketing: Quick sync: were greenlighting a nimble pricing page experiment this week. Objective: shorten the decision path for Dedicated commitments and capture higher-quality webinar signups.

leo_growth: Two variations proposed. Variant 1: "Calculator First"  show a compact estimator at the top with a one-line benchmark and single CTA. Variant 2: "FAQ-First"  keep estimator lower but reframe FAQ to proactively answer conversion blockers.

nina_engineering: We can ship a lightweight endpoint to power the estimator: GET /api/pricing-estimate?profile={workload}&region={EU|US} that returns JSON like: {"estimate_monthly_usd": 4200, "segment":"smb", "benchmark_profile":"high-throughput"}

carla_sales: Routing requirement: if segment=="enterprise" OR estimate_monthly_usd>50000 then tag lead as enterprise and push to enterprise_sdr queue. Also prefer a CSV export of the estimate and a short text summary for SDR notes.

sara_marketing: We’ll wire a hidden GTM variable pricing_bucket that maps to the segment. If engineering can emit pricing_bucket and an event save_estimate with a uuid, marketing can stitch that to webinar RSVP flows.

nina_engineering: Plan: add pricing_bucket (dev|smb|enterprise), uuid on save, and region-aware VAT flag. If region=EU we’ll return vat_included:true and adjusted numbers. Also providing two precomputed benchmark rows: low-latency and high-throughput with median p95 and median cost/token.

leo_growth: Webinar hook: title draft "Predictable Inference Costs: configuring for performance and price". The pricing page CTA should pass utm_campaign=pricing-webinar and include the uuid if present. We’ll use the same workload in the mini-benchmark on the page. Messaging should say "typical savings observed" and give ranges, e.g., "~15-35% lower cost per token with batch+quantization in high-throughput cases."

carla_sales: For lead handling: if a visitor elects to email results, prefill the webinar form and mark the lead as priority. Also, any EU lead that wants Private deployment should surface a contact link for on-prem/VPC sales (short one-liner about SLA options).

ops_bot: Reminder: design review today 4:30pm PT - https://calendar.redwood.ai/design-review

sara_marketing: Action list:
1) FAQ microcopy (3 short bullets per tier) - @carla_sales - Tue end of day.
2) Estimator endpoint + GTM fields + save flow - @nina_engineering - Thu.
3) Webinar CTA creative + benchmark copy - @leo_growth - Mon.
4) CSV export + one-line SDR summary - @nina_engineering + @carla_sales - Thu.

nina_engineering: Will return region and vat_included flags, and a small JSON payload compatible with the frontend. Also planning for a download endpoint that returns CSV: /api/estimate-csv?uuid=...

leo_growth: A/B hypothesis: moving the estimator above the fold (Variant 1) will increase webinar RSVP rate from pricing by 20% and reduce demo friction by improving qualification. Track: estimator interactions, email-captures, uuid-save events, webinar CTR, demo booking conversion, and enterprise-qualified leads.

carla_sales: Lead quality KPIs: demo-to-deal rate, average ACV expectation as reported in SDR notes, and time-to-first-contact.

sara_marketing: Localization: show VAT-inclusive numbers for EU and add a tiny footnote about Dedicated SLA options and Private contact form. @carla_sales will draft EU copy.

carla_sales: Will prepare EN/EU microcopy today.

sara_marketing: Perfect, thanks everyone :rocket:
